name: SDXL (built-in)
description: Reference blueprint mirroring batch_atlas.build_workflow's sdxl branch (checkpoint + LoRA + IPAdapter style ref). Copy it as a starting point for a new SDXL pipeline. CAVEAT: the static graph wires the style_ref (IPAdapter) path only — the built-in builder adds its ControlNet (shape_ref) branch DYNAMICALLY, which a static graph can't represent, so a driven sdxl blueprint does NOT do ControlNet (hence no shape_ref binding).
author: iw-builtin
